people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

translations.web: forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;
translations.bsb: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wages of wickedness.
translations.kjv: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
translations.asv: forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the hire of wrong-doing;
